title: Quartz sand surface-bound rice root exudates decreased the transport of microplastics in porous media
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1466-1476
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00984C, Paper
Genyao Gu, Dan Wu, Yanan Liu, Junfu Wang, Yunfei Zhang, Xiaopeng Min, Li Cai
Quartz sand surface-bound root exudates could decrease the transport of MPs in porous media, due to the lower DLVO energy barrier between MPs and quartz sand covered with root exudates.
